name: field
title: Field
description: Form field shell with label, description, and error parts.

meta.customization: Style the shell through mason-field classes and data-part values for root, label, description, and error.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers label/control/description/error relationships, required/disabled/invalid/read-only data, and field-oriented ARIA wiring. Gaps: Base UI form context, touched/dirty/filled/focused state, validation lifecycle, submit coordination, and control registration depth remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Follows Kobalte form-control direction with Solid context, generated IDs, aria-labelledby/describedby wiring, and data attributes. Gaps: form reset listener integration, native validation policy, grouped fieldsets, and richer error message registration remain follow-up work.
